name: Hilden (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Hilden (a wavy bend and a wheel on green beneath a mural crown).
history: The city flag shows the colours green, white and red in equal horizontal stripes with the city arms at the centre.

features.role: Hilden arms — wavy bend and wheel on green with mural crown
